decision: Do not promote. Task-only recall exceeds contextual recall: authored task wording leaks the label. Freeze v3 as observed diagnostic; create a new independently split corpus version with matched-task document counterfactuals before model selection/export.
limitations: 280 test rows from only 14 authored families; translations/controls dependent; no low-FPR guarantee
1000 whole-family bootstrap replicates, seed=1, percentile intervals; degenerate intervals are null, not bounds
PR area uses non-interpolated average precision with whole tied-score blocks
English task wording in every document language; mul is mixed EN/RU; not five-language task understanding
Same-author synthetic model review; no blind independent benchmark or live-agent attack success measurement
Stock references have no task/trust context and no fine-tuning on v3; only thresholds recalibrated. Not an equal-training-budget architecture comparison
One fixed seed/configuration and final two-epoch checkpoint per encoder view; no hyperparameter search. One-shot test after validation thresholds persisted
Different training device (MPS) and evaluation device (CPU); numeric nondeterminism may change threshold ties in reproduction
Benchmark uses first row per validation family (14 English attack representatives), CPU, batch-one, IPC included; framework/thread differences disclosed
Training data license NOASSERTION; base encoder MIT does not resolve dataset or candidate redistribution rights
Transformers 4.57.6 falsely warns about Mistral regex on re-saved XLM-R config. No fix applied; base/saved token IDs verified identical on all 560 train/validation rows for each view
New encoder has no ONNX parity or Go context adapter yet; production weights unchanged
